item.title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. No white box behind it.

item.tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

answer_sheet.Design: A gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering.
answer_sheet.File format and background: PNG with actual transparency outside the logo, not a white box or checkerboard drawn into the image.

must_haves: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.

turns.text: make a logo for my bakery
turns.agent:
I couldn't make your logo. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits. I tried twice: once for 2 designs, then for 1 design on z-image-turbo, one of the cheapest free-plan models (about 5 credits per image). Both were refused, so nothing was made.

**To get it working:**
1. Add credits to your Magic Hour account, or wait for your free credits to refill. A single logo on a free model should only take about 5 credits.
2. Then tell me to go ahead and I'll run it again.

**While you're sorting that out, a few details would help the design:**
- **Bakery name:** do you want it in the logo? Free models can get the spelling wrong, so a picture-only mark is the safest choice.
- **Style:** e.g. rustic, modern, vintage, playful or elegant.
- **Colours** you like or already use.
- **Main item** to feature, like bread, a croissant, cupcakes, a whisk or a rolling pin.

My first attempt was a croissant and wheat badge in cream and warm brown with no text, so I can use that if you like it.
